from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """Captures the financial metrics for a single company from one financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(..., description="Full name of the company as named in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(None, description="Stock exchange code if available (e.g., '000011')")
    roe_weighted_average: float = Field(..., description="Weighted average ROE as a decimal (e.g., 0.0151 for 1.51%)")
    equity_end_balance: float = Field(..., description="Ending equity attributable to shareholders (numeric value in CNY)")
    reporting_period: str = Field(..., description="The reporting period of the data (e.g., '2025-Q1')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for extracted data from a single document."""
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialRecord] = Field(..., description="List of companies extracted from this document")
